definitions.gloss: unique; peerless; matchless; one and only
definitions.explanation: Having no equal or duplicate; something or someone so special that there is no second.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{無二|むに}の{親友|しんゆう}だ。
examples.english: He is my one and only best friend.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}は{無二|むに}の{傑作|けっさく}と{言|い}われている。
examples.english: This work is said to be a peerless masterpiece.

examples.japanese: {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}の{存在|そんざい}である{彼女|かのじょ}を{失|うしな}ってから、{世界|せかい}が{色|いろ}を{失|うしな}ったように{感|かん}じた。
examples.english: After losing her — a truly one-of-a-kind presence — the world felt as if it had lost its color.

notes:
Literally means "without a second" — {無|む} (without/none) + {二|に} (two/second). The word expresses the idea that something is so exceptional that there is nothing else like it.

Most commonly encountered in the four-character compound {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに} (one and only; absolutely unique), which is widely used in both spoken and written Japanese. On its own, {無二|むに} appears primarily in the set phrase {無二|むに}の{親友|しんゆう} (irreplaceable best friend) and in literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無二|むに}の{親友|しんゆう}: irreplaceable best friend
- {唯一無二|ゆいいつむに}: one and only; absolutely unique
- {無二|むに}の{存在|そんざい}: a peerless existence

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {唯一|ゆいいつ}: the only; sole (more commonly used alone)
- {無比|むひ}: unrivaled; incomparable
- {無双|むそう}: peerless; unmatched
